purpose: Teach: ウキウキ/なんにも/おこる/ひと時/概して/めんどう/こまかい/やむを得ず

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんとお出かけでウキウキしてるね
lines.en: Sho, you're so excited about going out with your big sister Mei today, aren't you?
lines.style: Warm, conspiratorial notice. Soft smile in the voice. Observing the child's joy with genuine pleasure and a touch of teasing affection. No rush.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、なんにも怖くないよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm not scared of anything.
lines.style: Small chest puffed out. Quick, determined words. Child bravado — trying it on, seeing if it sticks. Brief pause after, like he's convincing himself too.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんはおこることがないのよ
lines.en: Sho, your sister Mei doesn't get angry with you.
lines.style: Quiet, certain. Speaking a small truth to steady him. Slight tilt toward tenderness — not explaining, just stating a fact he can hold onto. Steady breath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、メイ姉さんとひと時のお絵描きが楽しい
lines.en: Mei-sis, drawing with you is the best part of my day.
lines.style: Eager, unburdened. Words tumble out with genuine happiness. No performance — just a child telling someone he trusts what he actually feels. Bright and open.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんは、概して感情を見せない人なの
lines.en: Sho, your big sister keeps most of what she feels tucked away.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact acknowledgment with underneath gentleness. Speaking to the child's unasked question. Steady, not sad — just honest. Reflective pacing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お片付けがめんどうだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, putting everything back is kind of annoying.
lines.style: Small groan of realism. The practicality that bumps against joy. Not complaining — just the honest observation of a six-year-old. Slight eye-roll in the voice, but affectionate.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんは絵のこまかい所まで描くのよ
lines.en: Sho, your big sister draws every tiny detail, you know.
lines.style: Patient explanation tinged with quiet pride. Speaking about herself in third person as a small kindness to him. Slight warmth on the detail work — that's where her care shows. Unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お絵描きやめるのを、やむを得ずやめたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I had to stop drawing even though I didn't want to.
lines.style: Reluctant acceptance. The small sadness of something good ending too soon. Not whining — just stating the difficult fact. Voice trails slightly on the reluctance.
